# jamfplatform_pro_jamf_connect (Data Source)

Looks up the Jamf Connect deployment and update settings for a configuration profile that is linked to Jamf Connect (Settings → Jamf apps → Jamf Connect). Supply exactly one of `config_profile_uuid`, `profile_id`, or `profile_name`.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Create the API integration with **Platform environment** scope (preferred) or **Tenant** scope, then grant it the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deployment | Jamf Connect deployment | Read | `jamf-connect-deployments` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the Jamf Connect deployment settings for a configuration profile.
# Supply exactly one of config_profile_uuid, profile_id, or profile_name.

# By the configuration profile's Jamf Pro ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_jamf_connect" "by_id" {
  profile_id = 47
}

# By the configuration profile's display name (exact match).
data "jamfplatform_pro_jamf_connect" "by_name" {
  profile_name = "Jamf Connect Login"
}

output "connect_deployment_type" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_jamf_connect.by_id.auto_deployment_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config_profile_uuid` (String) Jamf Connect profile UUID. Supply this, `profile_id`, or `profile_name`.
- `profile_id` (Number) Jamf Pro ID of the configuration profile. Supply this, `config_profile_uuid`, or `profile_name`.
- `profile_name` (String) Display name of the configuration profile (exact match). Supply this, `config_profile_uuid`, or `profile_id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `auto_deployment_type` (String) How Jamf Connect is deployed and updated on the profile (`NONE`, `INITIAL_INSTALLATION_ONLY`, `PATCH_UPDATES`, or `MINOR_AND_PATCH_UPDATES`).
- `scope_description` (String) Human-readable summary of the configuration profile's scope.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the site the configuration profile belongs to. `-1` means none.
- `version` (String) Jamf Connect version configured for deployment. Empty when `auto_deployment_type` is `NONE`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
